theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+1.10%) and Technology (+0.12%) led the market today, while Communication Svcs (-1.89%) and Consumer Staples (-1.75%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.97%, defensives -0.75%, and value/cyclicals -0.29% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.52%, Dow -0.51%, Nasdaq -0.32% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.35%. The VIX rose 6.60% to 15.19, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.44% to $4,473.10, crude oil was little changed at $84.95, and bitcoin gained 2.35% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
